servers.name: telnyx
servers.description: Telnyx API MCP server — voice, messaging, networking, AI inference.

app_handshake.initialize: POST initialize with Accept: application/json, text/event-stream and Content-Type: application/json.
app_handshake.session: Retain the mcp-session-id response header and send it on subsequent JSON-RPC POSTs.
app_handshake.after_initialize: Call notifications/initialized. Public discovery: tools/list returns app-opening tools with _meta.ui.resourceUri; resources/list lists ui:// resources such as ui://number-intelligence/index.html; resources/read returns text/html;profile=mcp-app app HTML.
app_handshake.tool_calls: tools/call requires Authorization: Bearer <TELNYX_API_KEY> for Telnyx API-backed operations.
